sampling.policy: census -- every height.raw in the corpus, no subsampling
sampling.orphan_nested_note: unreachable second-level sectree dirs -- the client only ever opens <map>/%06u/<file>. Excluded from every statistic here; a **/height.raw glob would double-count them.

conventions.slope_definition: atan(hypot(gx,gy)) in degrees; gx/gy = mean of the cell's two X / two Y vertex deltas divided by CellScale; identical to m2map.codec.height.slope_degrees
conventions.percentile_note: percentiles from histograms are bin-centre estimates (+-0.025 deg slope, +-0.5 cm roughness); n/mean/std/min/max are exact
conventions.height_percentiles: exact -- computed from a 65536-bin bincount of the raw uint16 values
